english.title: Excluded traffic on a special road - animal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while

(A)_[riding]_
(B)_[in charge of]_

an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..), went or remained on a part of a special road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SPECIAL ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the animal was not a class of traffic authorised to use that road
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
riding/in charge of an animal use a special road - animal not traffic of a class authorised

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A special road includes motorways.
(ii) See regulation 15 of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982 for exceptions.
(iii) Excluded traffic also includes some motor vehicles - See H400 for the offence wording covering those instances.
(iv) See also H9757 to H9760 for other prohibited traffic.
(v) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
